Set image to null to send text only. See assets/README.md for the recommended layout.

default.text:
*Simfly Store — eSIM Activation* ⚡

Aapka eSIM activate karne ke liye:

1️⃣ Settings > Cellular / Mobile Data > *Add eSIM*
2️⃣ "Enter Details Manually" select karein
3️⃣ Activation code / QR scan karein
4️⃣ Line ko label dein (e.g. Simfly) > Continue
5️⃣ Data roaming *ON* kar lein

⚡ Activation foran — koi waiting nahi.

Koi masla ho toh isi chat me message karein. Shukriya! 🙏

plan_500mb.text:
500MB Activation Guide! 📲

1️⃣ Eskimo App download
   karein App Store /
   Play Store se ✅

2️⃣ Sign up karein
   email se ✅

3️⃣ "Have A Code?" pe
   tap karein aur
   yeh code daalen:
   🔑 SD55823 ✅

4️⃣ eSIM activate karein:
   iPhone: Settings →
   Mobile Data → Add eSIM
   → Scan QR ✅

   Samsung: Settings →
   Connections → SIM
   Manager → Scan QR ✅

   Oppo/Vivo/Xiaomi:
   Settings → Network →
   Add eSIM → Scan QR ✅

5️⃣ Mobile Data ON karein
   Eskimo select karein
   Internet shuru! 🚀

⏳ Validity: No Expiry!

❓ Masla ho? Batao! 💚
